briefings.tldr: Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) candidates have swept key New York congressional primaries, signaling a populist shift in the Democratic party, while China’s new open-weight GLM-5.2 model trained on indigenous Huawei silicon demonstrates that US export controls and regulatory hurdles are failing to slow foreign AI development.

briefings.tldr: Under the leadership of CEO Dara Khosrowshahi, Uber has transitioned from a chaotic startup into a highly profitable powerhouse generating over $10 billion in free cash flow.
